page.notes: Left margin note "Iudex solus Deus est." is printed as "Iudex so- / lus Deus / est." and is given as one note. The first line's opening word is a worn abbreviation read as "rũ" with doubt. Hebrew and Greek are copied as seen; the Greek word after "Christi nempe est" and the verb after "cluet" are doubtful. The Hebrew in the top lines is printed right to left and was copied in that order. The last line of the page ends with the catchword "ab" and the text continues on the next page. The note beside paragraph III is a marginal note, so it is marked as a note, not as a footnote.
